claim: The configuration single_cam_red_noDMD_nocom10.cfg loads no NIDAQ analogue-output device: its NIDAQ devices are NIDAQHub and the digital-output LUNF-Blanking only, so nothing in it addresses an analogue line such as Dev1/ao2.
validity_conditions: Read back in a preparatory run -- the first real acquisition on this computer, with no plan, the person having placed the 20x and moved the microscope by hand, software moving nothing. A device's report of itself may enter citing such a run (11-21 condition 4 as narrowed at 20a688b), graded as an observation by this system: E1 from `measured:`. Not a value of any registered observable. What it does NOT establish, and the run says so: whether NIDAQHub's own initialisation writes any analogue line, which happens inside the adapter and is not observable from Micro-Manager -- a gap in the device table. It matters because the piezo controller sums an analogue command with the digital one when its analogue input is enabled (npcd_analogue_and_digital_commands_are_summed); that input was reported disabled on 2026-09-24 (piezo_command_path_as_found_20260924).
